added_lines: that are important to read alongside the raw figures on each proposal. our delegates will gather with bishop nulty on 3rd november to reflect on the assembly and where it leads us now. our readings this weekend remind us of god’s love and compassion. we a re asked to live this out each day in our relations with god and with others. in the first reading god tells moses to teach the israelites the kind of care they are to show each other as children of god. in the gospe l jesus answers the question, ‘which is the greatest commandment?’ the answer is, of course, to love god – with our whole being. love of our neighbour is inextricable from this. this week we might strive to imitate christ’s love for us in the smallest details of our motives and actions with regard to others. congratulations - on the last sunday of october 2025 deacon sebastian was ordained for service in our diocese and our parish. today we congratulate him, his wife and family on the 1st anniversary of that special day and thank him for his ministry among us over the last 12 months. clocks change ‘back’ one hour this weekend to mark the end of summertime! good luck! best wishes to kilcavan gfc in their leinster club intermediate football championship game against dunlavin in o’moore park next saturday (31st) afternoon. the throw-in is at 2.30pm. all support welcome. mountmellick
